predict.question: You have a budget of 30, and each batch you run uses 10 work plus 5 switching. How much useful work completes?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Scheduling choices trade switching overhead against other performance goals.
modelBoundary: Short batches complete {A}; long batches complete {B}. Fewer batches pay fewer switches, increasing useful work in this fixed budget.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This accounts for setup only. Waiting time, fairness, concentration and the best real scheduling policy remain unmodeled.
